authority: AI-Assisted Software Engineering Governance Standard v1.0; FAT Readiness Roadmap RP-02.3; requirements Rev 1.6; private operational receipt v0.6 Choice A
classification: Source-first candidate assurance; pure synthetic execution, no sudo or device access, not independent acceptance
scope: Actually applied optional O1 time budget and call reservations; independently enforced SRC-13 privileged helper 32MiB and 60s cumulative quotas. No protected changes.

cases.stimulus: SRC-13/18/21 policy count exact boundary and next attempted source call
cases.expected: existing SourceCallBudget refuses before device execution; no asserted D-02 CaptureLimit for non-executed attempt

cases.stimulus: SRC-13/18/21 caller-side cumulative source seconds exactly exhausted
cases.expected: next call denied before transport; no inferred effective process threshold or unexecuted capture

cases.stimulus: SRC-13/18/21 process timed_out with preserved original bytes and no independently attested selected cap
cases.expected: private timed_out and TIME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED retained; no forged v0.6 witness; canonical rejects unproved D-02 time dimension

cases.stimulus: SRC-13 helper cumulative quota almost exhausted (bytes or seconds)
cases.expected: helper privately reduces effective request cap while original request remains unchanged; response schema does not attest applied cap
helper rejects without device operation; no source-level limit claim

cases.stimulus: SRC-13 helper internally reduced byte cap, positive omitted original
cases.expected: consumer retains omission without guessing applied effective threshold; canonical refuses unsupported D-02 promotion

cases.stimulus: SRC-13 helper internally shortened time cap, timed out
cases.expected: consumer retains timeout without inventing 12s per-target or 60s helper threshold; canonical refuses unsupported D-02

cases.stimulus: forged O1 source:entries, source:time and transport seconds facts
cases.expected: private receipt rejects unapproved scopes or canonical refuses unsupported time/entry fact

boundary_findings: SourceCallBudget tracks count and whole adapter elapsed time; `begin` can refuse an unexecuted call, which is not a reached capture-limit operation
Direct O1 _capture_child receives min(plan per-target time, caller source remaining, run wall remaining); actual selected cap is not separately persisted in an independently verifiable receipt
The helper _limit_run_request independently adjusts remaining 32MiB/60s SRC-13 per-run budget and emits no applied-limit fields in the installed wire protocol
An elapsed source interval includes transport setup/sealing and is not interchangeable with process-child timeout
Private receipts may truthfully report timeout or denial while D-02 CaptureLimit is withheld. The remaining coverage is a documented RP-02 gap, not permission to modify protected authority.
prohibitions: No modified fixed O1 argv, consent/privilege, helper protocol, source ceiling, canonical schema 1.0.0 or status schema 1.0
No assumed O1 time/count or helper shortened-limit proof
next: RP-03 exact F-06/D-02 producer-validator conformance. Retain open RP-02 time/call-count/helper effective threshold limitation until independent provenance or owner authorization permits closure.
